description: The pie chart titled “Answer Types” summarizes the distribution of problem formats in the dataset and contains three slices: an “Open-Answer (244)” slice shown in green at approximately 63.0%, a “Multi-Choice (127)” slice shown in orange at approximately 32.8% (its label appears partially obscured but the count “(127)” is visible), and a “True-False (16)” slice shown in blue at approximately 4.1%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, and the category names with counts are placed around the pie rather than in a separate legend; no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slices visually appear arranged from largest to smallest.
